final: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_category_ratio, AVG(cat_count) as avg_category_count, AVG(cat_count - avg_count) as avg_diff_from_overall_avg FROM (SELECT cs.category, cs.avg_ratio, cs.cat_count, oac.avg_count FROM (SELECT category, AVG((spent - amount) / NULLIF(amount, 0)) as avg_ratio, COUNT(*) as cat_count FROM budget GROUP BY category) cs, (SELECT AVG(cat_count) as avg_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cat_count FROM budget GROUP BY category)) oac WHERE cs.cat_count > oac.avg_count)
